description: Get corporate income tax (CIT) return data published by the Polish Ministry of Finance for the largest taxpayers (revenue above EUR 50 million), tax capital groups and real estate companies — revenue, tax-deductible costs, income, loss, tax base, tax due and effective rate for each year since 2020, plus national rank by tax due. These are tax-return categories (art. 12/15 CIT Act), not accounting figures: revenue and income differ from the financial statement (use get_financials for accounting revenue and income tax). Identify company by name, KRS, or NIP.

name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown.

name: get_company_corporate_tax
title: Get Corporate Income Tax (CIT)
